arxiv-1608-05327.title: A Short Counterexample Property for Safety and Liveness Verification of Fault-Tolerant Distributed Algorithms Thanks: This is an extended version of the paper that will appear at POPL’17, which can be accessed at: http://dx.doi.org/10.1145/3009837.3009860 We dedicate this article to the memory of He
arxiv-1608-05327.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by . Distributed algorithms have many mission-critical applications ranging from embedded systems and replicated databases to cloud computing. Due to asynchronous communication, process faults, or network failures, these algorithms are difficult to design and verify. Many algorithms achieve fault tolerance by using threshold guards that, for instance, ensure that a process waits until it has received an acknowledgment from a majority of its peers. Consequently, domain-specific languages for fault-tolerant distributed systems offer language support for threshold guards.

arxiv-2106-09460.title: DravidianCodeMix: Sentiment Analysis and Offensive Language Identification Dataset for Dravidian Languages in Code-Mixed Text Journal: Language Resources and Evaluation Journal
arxiv-2106-09460.creator: Bharathi Raja Chakravarthi 1, Ruba Priyadharshini 2, Vigneshwaran Muralidaran 3, Navya Jose 4, Shardul Suryawanshi 1, Elizabeth Sherly 4, John P. McCrae 1
arxiv-2106-09460.description: Abstract This paper describes the development of a multilingual, manually annotated dataset for three under-resourced Dravidian languages generated from social media comments. The dataset was annotated for sentiment analysis and offensive language identification for a total of more than 60,000 YouTube comments.

arxiv-2206-08477.title: Backdoor Attacks on Vision Transformers
arxiv-2206-08477.creator: Akshayvarun Subramanya Aniruddha Saha Soroush Abbasi Koohpayegani, Ajinkya Tejankar Hamed Pirsiavash
arxiv-2206-08477.description: Abstract Vision Transformers (ViT) have recently demonstrated exemplary performance on a variety of vision tasks and are being used as an alternative to CNNs. Their design is based on a self-attention mechanism that processes images as a sequence of patches, which is quite different compared to CNNs. Hence it is interesting to study if ViTs are vulnerable to backdoor attacks.

arxiv-2410-15689.title: Enhancing SNN-based Spatio-Temporal Learning: A Benchmark Dataset and Cross-Modality Attention Model
arxiv-2410-15689.creator: Shibo Zhou, Bo Yang, Mengwen Yuan, Runhao Jiang, Rui Yan, Gang Pan, Huajin Tang
arxiv-2410-15689.description: Abstract Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), renowned for their low power consumption, brain-inspired architecture, and spatio-temporal representation capabilities, have garnered considerable attention in recent years. Similar to Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), high-quality benchmark datasets are of great importance to the advances of SNNs.

arxiv-2502-12613.title: Two-body strong decays of the hidden-charm tetraquark molecular states via the QCD sum rules
arxiv-2502-12613.description: Abstract In this work, we extend our previous work on the D ∗ ​ D ¯ ∗ D^{*}\bar{D}^{*} molecular states with the J P ​ C = 0 + ⁣ + J^{PC}=0^{++} , 1 + ⁣ − 1^{+-} and 2 + ⁣ + 2^{++} to investigate their two-body strong decays via the QCD sum rules based on rigorous quark-hadron duality.

arxiv-2504-08942.title: AgentRewardBench : Evaluating Automatic Evaluations of Web Agent Trajectories
arxiv-2504-08942.creator: Xing Han Lù 1 2 Amirhossein Kazemnejad * 2
arxiv-2504-08942.description: Abstract Web agents enable users to perform tasks on web browsers through natural language interaction. Evaluating web agents trajectories is an important problem, since it helps us determine whether the agent successfully completed the tasks. Rule-based methods are widely used for this purpose, but they are challenging to extend to new tasks and may not always recognize successful trajectories.

arxiv-2510-24073.title: Challenging Multilingual LLMs: A New Taxonomy and Benchmark for Unraveling Hallucination in Translation
arxiv-2510-24073.creator: Xinwei Wu, Heng Liu, Jiang Zhou, Xiaohu Zhao, Linlong Xu, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Kaifu Zhang
arxiv-2510-24073.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced machine translation but remain vulnerable to hallucinations. Unfortunately, existing MT benchmarks are not capable of exposing failures in multilingual LLMs. To disclose hallucination in multilingual LLMs, we introduce a diagnostic framework with a taxonomy that separates Instruction Detachment from Source Detachment.

pmc-10670564.title: Teachers’ and Parents’ Assessment of Challenges in Children Exhibiting Sensory Seeking Behavior and Possible Effects of the Use of Ball Vests: A Pre–Post Study
pmc-10670564.creator: Ann Natasja Nielsen, Karen la Cour, Åse Brandt
pmc-10670564.description: Children with dysfunction in sensory processing (DSP) may experience challenges, which might affect their participation in activities and potentially also their further development. This study examined the challenges of children with DSP who exhibit sensory seeking behavior, the differences in these challenges between boys and girls, and the possible effects of their use of ball vests.

pmc-10714464.creator: Kholoud B Saad, Samir I Bakry, Rewaa G AboElhassan
pmc-10714464.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). pmc-11341571.title: Sensing emotional valence and arousal dynamics through automated facial action unit analysis
pmc-11341571.creator: Junyao Zhang, Wataru Sato, Naoya Kawamura, Koh Shimokawa, Budu Tang, Yuichi Nakamura
pmc-11341571.description: Information about the concordance between dynamic emotional experiences and objective signals is practically useful. Previous studies have shown that valence dynamics can be estimated by recording electrical activity from the muscles in the brows and cheeks. However, whether facial actions based on video data and analyzed without electrodes can be used for sensing emotion dynamics remains unknown.

pmc-11355710.description: In order to systematize and expand knowledge about copper-containing composite materials as hybrid ion exchangers, in this study, fine metallic copper particles were dispersed within the matrix of a carboxyl cation exchanger (CCE) with a macroporous and gel-type structure thanks to the reduction of Cu2O particles precipitated within the matrix earlier. It was possible to introduce as much as 22.

pmc-11363885.title: A Case of a Giant Siliconoma Mimicking Localized Breast Cancer
pmc-11363885.creator: Virginie Van Boeckel, Denis Danthine, Jean-Luc Nizet
pmc-11363885.description: Silicone gel–filled breast implants are widely used for breast augmentation and reconstruction after mastectomy. However, there are some known complications associated with silicone implants: Leakage and migration of silicone particles from the implant cause a granulomatous reaction. Granulomas may present as masses with features of malignancy on breast MRI.

pmc-11434174.title: Quantitative Study of Vitamin K in Plants by Pressurized Liquid Extraction and LC-MS/MS
pmc-11434174.creator: Iryna Bryshten, Łukasz Paprotny, Małgorzata Olszowy-Tomczyk, Dorota Wianowska
pmc-11434174.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The health-promoting properties of vitamin K stimulate the growing interest in this compound, which translates into the development of new analytical methodologies for its determination. New, more efficient methods of its isolation are sought, paying increasingly more attention to the methods within currently available extraction techniques that, owing to the optimization of the process, not only increase the extraction efficiency but are also economical and environmentally friendly.

pmc-11467075.title: Assessment of oxidative stress biomarkers in Palaemon varians exposed to deep eutectic systems
pmc-11467075.creator: Mª Pilar Garralaga, Ines Ferreira, Laura Lomba, Elisabet Pires, Sara Gracia-Barberán, Ana Rita C Duarte, Mário Diniz
pmc-11467075.description: In recent years, there has been extensive research within the scientific community on deep eutectic systems due to their remarkable versatility in solubilizing diverse substances and serving as effective solvents in catalytic processes. While initially regarded as non-toxic, a comprehensive toxicological assessment is essential to comprehend their behavior within organisms.

pmc-11731806.title: Global prevalence and contributing factors of transplant renal artery stenosis in renal transplant recipients: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11731806.creator: Fredo Tamara, Jonny K. Fajar, Camoya Gersom, Ramadi S. Wicaksono, Alvira R. Tupamahu, Fariz N. Huda, Fitria R. Sari, Jamaludin A. Dela, Irawati E. Putri, Muhammad A. Sutrisno, Riyantono Putra, Michael Dwinata, Yudha Friatna, Thoha M. Albaar, Agung Susanto, Ratih TK. Dewi, Aryo Suseno, Nur Samsu
pmc-11731806.description: Transplant renal artery stenosis (TRAS) is a serious complication of renal transplantation, with its prevalence and associated factors remaining inconclusive. The aim of this study was to assess the global prevalence and risk factors associated with TRAS incidence in renal transplant recipients.

pmc-13524398.title: Protein farnesylation: from molecular mechanisms to therapeutic targeting in cancer, aging, and beyond
pmc-13524398.creator: Jiacheng Lou, Danlu Zhang, Yingjie Wang
pmc-13524398.description: Protein farnesylation, catalyzed by farnesyltransferase (FTase), covalently attaches a 15-carbon farnesyl lipid to cysteine residues within C-terminal CaaX motifs. This modification governs the subcellular localization, protein–protein interactions, and activity of diverse eukaryotic proteins, including Ras GTPases, nuclear lamins, molecular chaperones, and kinetochore components.

pmc-13642535.title: Visualizing and Optimizing Phase Matching in Nonlinear Guided‐Mode Resonators With the Green's Function Integral Method
pmc-13642535.creator: Chengkang Liang, Quanying Li, Jiale Xu, Pingqi Gao, Jiancan Yu
pmc-13642535.description: Efficient nonlinear frequency conversion in nanophotonics requires not only strong fundamental field but also precise phase matching among distributed nonlinear sources. Here, we develop the two‐dimensional Green's function integral method (GFIM) to directly visualize and optimize phase matching in nonlinear guided‐mode resonators.

uslaw-usc-t42-s15881.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s15881.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 149 (National Energy Policy And Programs); Subchapter II (Renewable Energy); Part C (Hydroelectric). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Incentive payments For electric energy generated and sold by a qualified hydroelectric facility during the incentive period, the Secretary shall make, subject to the availability of appropriations, incentive payments to the owner.
